title: Interlock Logic & Cause Effect Matrix - FA-8901 (SEQ-8901)
content:
INTERLOCK LOGIC & CAUSE EFFECT MATRIX: SEQ-8901 (REFLUX ACCUMULATOR (FA-8901) OVERHEAD PROTECTION LOGIC).
Document No: TJC-LLD-IL-FA-8901, Revision: Rev 3, SIL Level: SIL 1.
Equipment: FA-8901, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-8900-01.
CAUSE & EFFECT MATRIX (TRIPS):
- T1: Drum level HIGH-HIGH (LSHH-8901 > 85 %, 1oo2) -> Actions: Trip Feed (EFF-1), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
- T2: Drum level LOW-LOW (LSLL-8901 < 15 %, 1oo2) -> Actions: Trip Pump (EFF-2), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
- T3: Drum pressure HIGH-HIGH (PSHH-8902 > 8 barg, 1oo2) -> Actions: Open Vent (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
- T4: Emergency stop (manual) (HS-8901 Manual, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip Feed (EFF-1), Trip Pump (EFF-2), Open Vent (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
START PERMISSIVES (AND-gate conditions to start pump):
- P1: Level in normal band (20-80%) (LT-8901, Gate Logic: AND)
- P2: N2 blanket healthy (PT-8902, Gate Logic: AND)
- P3: Boot not flooded (LT-8903, Gate Logic: AND)
- P4: No active trip / reset done (DCS reset, Gate Logic: AND)
- —: ALL permissives TRUE → START FA-8901 ENABLED (—, Gate Logic: AND)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-8901, Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-FA-8901.
